headline: Leeds 0-0 Palace: unbeaten on nine, not third
whyCareReason: Leeds stay unbeaten on 9 points from five. IOL: a Mitchell finish was ruled out. ESPN UK prints 0-0.
teaser: FINAL: Leeds United 0-0 Crystal Palace. ESPN UK: no goals. Leeds fifth on 9.
story:
Why this one matters: Leeds sat on eight points from four after beating Newcastle. Sunday at Elland Road finished 0-0.

ESPN UK: no goals. IOL: Tyrick Mitchell thought he had given Palace the lead in the second half. The finish was ruled out for offside in the build-up.

ESPN UK table: Leeds 5 2 3 0, 7 3, 9, fifth. Palace 5 1 1 3, 6 11, 4, 15th. IOL: Leeds missed the chance to go third.
stakes: Nine points is the unbeaten pack. Third stays with Brighton on 10.
rivalryAngle: A promoted side still unbeaten against a Palace team hunting a first point of the week.
